name: 衣装スタッフ
text:
──あ、来た来た
美琴ちゃん
trans:
―Oh, she's finally here!
Mikoto-chan!

name: 美琴
text: ……遅くなってごめんなさい
trans: ...I'm sorry for arriving late.

name: 衣装スタッフ
text:
ううん、大丈夫
少し遅れるってプロデューサーさんからも聞いてたし
trans:
Nah, you're good.
Your Producer-san also gave me a heads
up that you're running late, anyway.

name: 衣装スタッフ
text:
にちかちゃんはもう来てて、
今そっちで着替えてもらってるの
trans:
Nichika-chan already got here earlier,
so she's currently dressing up over there.

name: 美琴
text: ……そうなんだ
trans: ...I see.

name: 美琴
text:
…………
いいね、新しい衣装も
trans:
......
Looks good. Both her and the new outfit.

name: 衣装スタッフ
text:
本当？　よかった
サイズも見たいし、着てみて
trans:
Really? That's a relief to hear.
I want to see how the sizing fits you,
so go ahead and wear yours too.

name: にちか
text:
じゃじゃーん！
着てみましたー──────あっ……
trans:
Ta-daaaah! Transformation all do―
―ah......

name: にちか
text:
美琴さん……！
いらっしゃってたんですね……！
trans:
Mikoto-san...!
You're already here, huh...!

name: 美琴
text:
うん
今来たところ
trans:
Yep.
Got here just a moment ago.

name: にちか
text: そ、そうだったんですね……！
trans: O-Oh, is that so...!

name: にちか
text:
あ……えっと
先に着てみたんですけど……
trans:
Ah... Uhm...
I went ahead and put it on before you, though...

name: 美琴
text:
……うん
いいと思う、似合ってる
trans:
...Yep. I think it looks good.
It fits you well.

name: 美琴
text:
動きづらいところがないかだけ
しっかり確認した方がよさそう
trans:
Though, I think you should thoroughly check
if there's gonna be any parts that might
constrain your movements.

name: 美琴
text: パフォーマンスにも関わるから
trans: Since it'll affect your performance too.

name: にちか
text:
……はい……！
ですよね……！
trans:
...Got it......!
You're right on that...!

name: にちか
text:
衣装はぴったりって感じなんですけど
やっぱりヒールが不安定で……
trans:
The outfit itself is like, perfect to a tee, but...
I definitely still feel off when wearing heels...

name: 美琴
text:
……それは
練習で慣れるしかなさそう
trans:
I think that part is... something you just
have to get used to through practice.

name: にちか
text:
はい……！
ヒールでのダンスレッスンもしなきゃだなって
trans:
Understood...!
I also thought that I should do more
dance lessons while wearing heels!

name: 美琴
text: うん、そうだね
trans: Yep, that would do.

name: 衣装スタッフ
text: ……ふふっ
trans: ...Hehe.

name: 衣装スタッフ
text:
にちかちゃんがヒールを履くと
身長同じくらいだね、ふたり
trans:
You two look like you're at the same height
when Nichika-chan alone wears heels like that.

name: にちか
trans: Huh...?

name: 美琴
text:
……そうかも
目線、近いみたい
trans:
...It does look like that.
Feels like our eyes levels are pretty close.

name: 美琴
text: いつもより
trans: Closer than usual.

name: 美琴
text:
それじゃあ
私も着てみるね
trans: Well then, I'm going to get dressed too.

name: 衣装スタッフ
text: はーい
trans: Okie-dokieee.

name: にちか
text:
…………
美琴さんの目線────
trans:
......
Mikoto-san's eye level......

name: 美琴
text: ──着てみたけど
trans: —I'm done changing now, but...

name: 美琴
text:
……少し緩いみたい
腰回り
trans:
...I think it's a bit loose.
Around the waist area.

name: 衣装スタッフ
text: 本当？　じゃあ少し詰めないと
trans:
Really?
M'kay, we gotta tighten that up then.

name: 美琴
text:
だけど、それ以外はいい感じ
……すごく
trans:
It feels good asides from that, though.
...Like, very good.

name: 衣装スタッフ
text:
それなら良かった
今回の衣装、気に入った？
trans:
That's good to hear!
Do you like your outfit this time?

name: 美琴
text:
うん、とても
ありがとう、素敵な物を用意してくれて
trans:
Yep, very much. 
Thank you for making such a wonderful outfit.

name: 美琴
text:
……？
どうしたの？
trans:
...Hm?
Something wrong?

name: にちか
text:
あ……い、いえ……！
美琴さん、すごくお似合いだなって……！
trans:
Ah... N-No, it's nothing...!
Just thinking that it looks really
great on you, Mikoto-san...!

name: 美琴
text: ……そう？
trans: ...You think?

name: にちか
text: あっ、えっと、当たり前なんですけどそんなこと……！
trans:
Ah, uhm, I mean, obviously it's
made for you and all, but...!

name: にちか
text:
美琴さん、なんでも似合って
当然──……
trans:
You just look so wonderful
in anything, Mikoto-san...
So, of course—

name: 美琴
text: ……目線
trans: ...Our eye levels.

name: 美琴
text: いつもと一緒になっちゃったね
trans: It went back to the usual.

name: にちか
text:
そ、そっか……
美琴さんもヒールだから────
trans:
O-Oh, I see...
Mikoto-san does wear heels too, after all......

name: 美琴
text: ……うん
trans: ...Yep.

name: にちか
text:
美琴さんからは、きっと……
ステージからすごく遠いとこまで見えてるんですよね
trans:
I guess from your perspective... You can probably
see all the way to the back of the venue from
the stage, can't you, Mikoto-san?

name: 美琴
text: ……そうかもしれない
trans: ...Yeah, I guess.

name: 美琴
text: だけど、まだ伸びるんじゃない？
trans:
But you still have a chance
to get taller yourself, no?

name: 美琴
text: これから
trans: You'll get there too.
